specific_diseases_listed: Hypertension/Diabetes/Cardiac (reduced to 30/60 days via Early Start add-on)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Both Indemnity and Benefit. Early Start add-on reduces HBP/Diabetes/Cardiac waiting to 30/60 days. Health Multiplier for 37 listed serious illnesses enhances SI by multiplier.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Admission beyond 24 hours - up to Sum Insured
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Health Multiplier enhances SI for 37 listed serious illnesses. Shared accommodation cash benefit for daily cash.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for inpatient AYUSH

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Maternity Expenses including Pre-natal and Post-natal check-ups (Maternity and Related Expenses Cover)

newborn_coverage.limit_text: New Born Baby Cover up to amount specified
newborn_coverage.notes: Plus Child Vaccination Cover until age 12.

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Health Multiplier benefit for 37 listed serious illnesses (SI enhanced by multiplier)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Not a lump-sum CI cover, but SI multiplier for serious illnesses.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: ReInsure Benefit: unlimited times up to 100%/200% of SI for subsequent claims; Enhanced ReInsure (optional) up to 200% Basic SI

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual Health Check-up for listed preventive tests

copayment_trigger_notes: Optional 10%/20% co-payment per Policy Schedule on each admissible claim.

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Medical Treatment Abroad for Listed Major Illness (diagnosis in India required) - up to Base SI
worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Planned treatment abroad for listed conditions.

permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (unless Medical Treatment Abroad rider)
temporary_exclusions: HBP/DM/Cardiac (reduced via Early Start to 30/60 days)
notable_exclusions_summary: Super Health Insurance is the most comprehensive SBI variant featuring Health Multiplier (SI enhancement for 37 serious illnesses), ReInsure Benefit (100%/200% unlimited restoration), Loyalty Credit (50% SI bump per renewal), Maternity & Newborn coverage, OPD/Dental/Vision, Medical Treatment Abroad, Home Health Care, and Wellness Benefit. Early Start add-on reduces HBP/Diabetes/Cardiac waiting periods.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospitals; reimbursement via document submission. 18001021111.
available_riders: Additional Basic SI for Accidental Hospitalization (2x)
Early Start (reduce HBP/DM/Cardiac waiting to 30/60 days)
Enhanced Cumulative Bonus (50% per claim-free year)
Loyalty Credit (50% SI per renewal regardless of claim)
top_rider_examples: Health Multiplier (37 serious illnesses SI bump)
